I don’t have real‑time access to current weather data, so I can’t give you the exact temperature in Tel Aviv right now.  
If you need the current Fahrenheit reading, you can check a reliable weather service such as:

- **Weather.com** (search “Tel Aviv” → “Current conditions”)
- **AccuWeather** (search “Tel Aviv” → “Current temperature”)
- **OpenWeatherMap** API (if you have an API key, call `https://api.openweathermap.org/data/2.5/weather?q=Tel%20Aviv&units=imperial&appid=YOUR_API_KEY`)

Those sources will give you the up‑to‑minute temperature in Fahrenheit.
